content.text: {"id": "mm6145a4", "data_focus": {"v": "yes", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "with the median prevalence for all states, DC, and Puerto Rico increasing from 4.5% to 8.2%"}, {"loc": "summary", "q": "Based on self-reported data collected during 1995–2010 by the Behavioral Risk Factor Surveillance System"}]}, "outcome_types": [{"v": "binary/categorical", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "the prevalence of diagnosed diabetes was calculated as the percentage of the population answering \"yes\""}]}], "analytic_depth": [{"v": "summary", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "with the median prevalence for all states, DC, and Puerto Rico increasing from 4.5% to 8.2%"}]}, {"v": "comparison", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "In 2010, median age-adjusted prevalence was highest among states in the South (9.8%) versus states in the Midwest (7.5%)"}]}, {"v": "stratified/adjusted", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "Estimates were age-adjusted using the 2000 U.S. standard population"}]}], "study_design": [{"v": "cross-sectional", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "ongoing, random-digit–dialed telephone surveys of noninstitutionalized U.S. civilian adults"}]}, {"v": "before/after or trend", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "Trends from 1995–2010 were assessed using BRFSS data."}]}], "methods_quotes": [{"loc": "text", "q": "State-specific and regional trends in age-adjusted diagnosed diabetes prevalence incorporating all 16 years of BRFSS data were assessed using least squares regression."}, {"loc": "text", "q": "Linear and quadratic terms for time (year of survey) were included in the models."}, {"loc": "text", "q": "Sampling weights and statistical software that account for the complex sampling design of BRFSS were used to estimate state prevalence"}, {"loc": "note", "q": "Age-adjusted to the 2000 U.S. standard population; weighted estimates."}, {"loc": "note", "q": "Nonsignificant quadratic terms were dropped from the models."}], "confidence": "high", "uncertain_fields": []}
